about: A/D-Only style oracle from apps/web/src/styles.ts (tools/verify/adonly-vectors.ts). Rows: StyleFilter.apply(cmd, {grounded, onLadder, edgeLanding}, running) on one A/D-Only filter (physics 25), in order; reset = filter.reset() before the row. out = the filtered command; lock = sideLock after the row (-1 A, 1 D, 0 none). cmd/out: forward, side, yaw (f32 value), pitch, buttons.

sequence.note: idle, ground, W+A: ground is free
idle, air, D: before the run both keys work
idle, air, A
idle, air, W: blocked
idle, air, S: blocked
running, ground jump tick with D: ground is free, no lock
running, air, nothing pressed: no lock
running, air, A and D held (cancel): no lock
running, air, W+A: locks A, W blocked
running, air, D: blocked
running, air, W+D: both blocked
running, air, A: works
running, air, A over a held D: A works, D's bit cleared
running, air, D over a held A: blocked; no sidemove left, so both side bits go
running, air, both held (cancel): no sidemove, both side bits go
running, ground, W+D: ground is free, lock kept
running, v22 edge landing without jump = air: D blocked
running, v22 edge landing with jump = ground: D free
running, ladder: free
running, air right after the ladder: no grace, D blocked
running, air after the ladder: W+D blocked
running, air after the ladder: S blocked
running, air after the ladder: A works
running, landed: ground free
running, air: D still blocked (lock kept through the ladder)
reset(); running, ladder with D: free, locks nothing
running, first air tick off the ladder, D: locks D (no grace)
running, air, W+A: both blocked
idle (back in the start zone): lock clears
running, air, D: locks D
running, air, A: blocked
running, air, D over a held A (null binds): D works, A's bit cleared
reset(): lock clears; running, air, A over a held D locks A
running, air, D: blocked
